selection_reasoning: These 4 tasks form a coherent multi-hop survival scenario. The player must first explore to find birch_leaves (establishing location awareness), then mine oak_wood to obtain fuel/materials. Oak wood is needed as fuel in a furnace to craft cooked_porkchop (smelting raw porkchop). Finally, the player must light up the home using torches or other light sources, which requires coal/charcoal (obtainable from smelting wood) and sticks (from oak wood planks). This creates a branching dependency where mining oak_wood enables both cooking and lighting tasks, while finding birch_leaves serves as an orientation/exploration prerequisite that helps locate the home area.

edges.reason: Birch leaves help locate the forest area where oak trees are also present for mining
Oak wood serves as fuel (or converted to charcoal) in the furnace to smelt raw porkchop into cooked_porkchop
Oak wood provides planks for sticks and charcoal for crafting torches to light up the home

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the birch trees (centered around spawn-relative [-8, 5, 3] and [-12, 4, 6]) and face them to demonstrate they have located the birch leaves. Max distance of 16 blocks and facing tolerance of 60 degrees models 'player can see the birch leaves'.

Uses inventory_has because mining oak_log blocks drops oak_log items into the player's inventory. The scene has oak_log blocks at spawn-relative [-5, 0-3, -5] and [-3, 0-3, -3]. The player has a diamond axe to mine them. The task says 'mine oak_wood' which colloquially means mining oak tree logs; the actual item ID is 'oak_log'.

Uses inventory_has because smelting raw porkchop in the furnace produces cooked_porkchop which appears in the player's inventory when collected. The player starts with raw porkchop (x3) and must use oak_log as fuel in the furnace at spawn-relative [12, 1, 12]. The cooked_porkchop is not in the starting inventory so its presence confirms successful smelting.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='wall_torch') because the player must place torches inside the dark house interior. When torches are placed on walls they become 'wall_torch' blocks; when placed on floor they become 'torch' blocks. The house interior spans spawn-relative [9,1,9] to [13,3,13]. Using a generous box of [8,1,8] to [14,3,14] to account for placement on walls. Checking for at least 1 torch block of either type. Using two rules (torch OR wall_torch) — either satisfies the milestone since we only need one torch placed anywhere inside.

scene_description: A survival homestead scene with a dark oak-plank house (containing furnace and crafting table), surrounded by birch trees to the west and oak trees to the northwest. Two pigs roam near spawn. The player starts with a diamond sword, diamond axe, raw porkchop (x3), and torches (x8). The house interior is unlit, requiring the player to place torches inside.
task_text: Find birch leaves in the nearby birch trees, then mine oak wood from the oak trees using your diamond axe. Use the furnace inside the house to cook raw porkchop into cooked porkchop. Finally, light up the dark interior of the house by placing torches inside.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin. House at ~8-14, ~0-4, ~8-14 (SE quadrant) with door facing west at ~8,~1,~11. Interior has furnace at ~12,~1,~12 and crafting table at ~11,~1,~12. Oak trees at ~-5,~0,~-5 and ~-3,~0,~-3 (NW quadrant). Birch trees at ~-8,~0,~3 and ~-12,~0,~6 (W quadrant). Pigs at ~3,~0,~3 and ~4,~0,~2. Player given raw porkchop (for smelting), torches (for lighting), diamond axe (for mining oak), and diamond sword (for killing pigs if needed). The house interior is dark (no windows, enclosed) requiring torch placement.
